assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq 6000, 100 bp PE), STAR to rn7, featureCounts, Partek Flow DESeq2 (S4.9.p1)

group: Cancer + Ex (DMBA + 8 weeks moderate aerobic treadmill training)

sample_inclusion: four animals per group per tissue (S4.9.p1; Fig3 legend n=4/4/4; Fig4 legend tumor Cancer n=4, Cancer+Ex n=4)
primary_estimand: Effect of 8-week moderate aerobic training in DMBA tumor-bearing rats on tibialis anterior gene expression: Cancer+Ex vs Cancer (S2.2.p1, Table S2); Cancer vs Non-Cancer and Cancer+Ex vs Non-Cancer are the paper's other planned tibialis contrasts
planned_contrasts: Tibialis Cancer vs Non-Cancer (S2.2.p1; paper: 523 up / 30 down = 553)
Tibialis Cancer+Ex vs Non-Cancer (S2.2.p1; paper: 1276 up / 744 down = 2020)
Tibialis Cancer+Ex vs Cancer (S2.2.p1, Table S2; paper: 10 up / 16 down = 26)
Tumor Cancer+Ex vs Cancer (S2.3.p2, Fig4, Table S4; paper: 24 up / 132 down = 156) - separate case
repeated_measure_unit: none within a tissue; the same animals contribute tibialis and tumor (title numbers 2,3,4,7,31,33,38,39) but tissues are analyzed separately
normalization: DESeq2 median ratio in Partek Flow; noise filter <=10 (GEO data_processing)
paper_method: DESeq2 (Partek Flow v11.0), per tissue, three-group model for tibialis

paper_threshold.source_locator: S4.9.p1 (fold change >|2| and FDR < 0.05); S2.2.p1 (fold change >|2| and adjusted p < 0.05)
